items.text: BoC's Senior Dep. Gov. Rogers: What we see happening right now is a repricing of risk, not a situation where liquidity is drying up.
BoC's Senior Dep. Gov. Rogers: It is important to distinguish between volatility and dysfunction or instability.
BoC's Gov. Macklem: We are seeing some spillover of global bond yields into Canada, we will take that into account.
